_comment: Generated by scripts/sync-sources.py from thamizh-mcp/data/sources.json. Do not edit by hand.

A.means: Primary authority — the classical text itself, or a rule table derived from it and carrying its நூற்பா.

B.means: Scholarly or institutional publication — peer-reviewed, or published by a government body; named editors, stable citation, versioned release.

C.means: Community-edited and revisable — anyone may change it, so a claim is only as good as the revision it was read from. Citable per revision, not per work.

D.means: Unattributed compilation — no named editor, no stated terms, no active maintenance. Usable as attested evidence, never as authority.

redistribution_modes.redistribute: Ship the data as a version-locked artifact in the public repo.
redistribution_modes.serve-with-attribution: Cache and serve; attribution travels with every claim; never relicensed.
redistribution_modes.consult-and-cite: Consult to establish a FACT; store the fact plus the citation, never the source's own wording. Excluded from gold-corpus export.

tholkappiyam.name: Tholkappiyam
tholkappiyam.licence: The work is public domain (classical). The pinned Project Madurai etext is distributable provided its header is kept intact.
tholkappiyam.attribution: © Project Madurai 1999-2001. Etext: Dr. K. Kalyanasundaram; proof-reading: N. D. Logasundaram.
tholkappiyam.maintenance: stable — a pinned etext of a fixed classical work; drift is detectable via scripts/build_classical.py --verify
tholkappiyam.notes: நூற்பா RESTART per இயல் — a citation must name அதிகாரம் › இயல் › நூற்பா. Never take a number from a secondary source; TVA's 336 is 337 here.

nannul.name: Nannūl
nannul.licence: The work is public domain (classical). The pinned Project Madurai etext is distributable provided its header is kept intact.
nannul.attribution: © Project Madurai 1999-2001. Etext: Dr. Thomas Malten (Univ. of Köln), conforming to the edition of Mani Thirunavukkarasu Mudaliar (Vavilla Ramasamy Sastrulu & Sons, Madras, 1926); proof-reading: N. D. Logasundaram.
nannul.pin: projectmadurai.org/pm_etexts/utf8/pmuni0147.html (+ pmuni0152 for gap-fill); sha256 in data/PINS.md; retrieved 2026-08-02
nannul.maintenance: stable — pinned etext, complete at all 462 நூற்பா
nannul.notes: Continuous 1–462, so a bare number is unambiguous. நூற்பா 73 and 176 are supplemented from the older 2002 etext and marked per-verse in the artifact.

curated_rule_tables.name: thamizh-mcp cited rule tables
curated_rule_tables.notes: Grade A is earned by the நூற்பா citation each table carries, not by being ours. tests/test_citations.py fails any table without a source_priority block, and every cited verse must resolve in data/classical/.

curated_verb_paradigms.name: thamizh-mcp curated verb paradigms
curated_verb_paradigms.notes: Graded B, NOT A: these are hand-curated inflection tables, and only some entries carry a நூற்பா. Four entries (சொல், கல், கேள், வில்) are under an open ruling — see data/grammar/concept_map.json → concepts.விகாரம்.inferred.

supersession.intent: Superseded per-lemma as ThamizhiMorph coverage grows; the fallback exists because the FST returns NoEntry for ~12 irregular verbs, not because we prefer our own data.

thamizhimorph.name: ThamizhiMorph
thamizhimorph.attribution: Sarveswaran, K., Dias, G., Butt, M. — 'ThamizhiMorph: A morphological parser for the Tamil language', Machine Translation (Springer) 2021. DOI 10.1007/s10590-021-09261-5.
thamizhimorph.notes: Peer-reviewed and Apache-2.0 — B rather than A because it is a computational model of the grammar, not the grammar. Where the FST and a நூற்பா disagree, the நூற்பா governs.

english_loanwords_dakshina.name: Google Dakshina (attested romanizations)
english_loanwords_dakshina.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 — inherited from Dakshina. NOT Apache-2.0 and never relicensed. (The dwyl/english-words wordlist component is Unlicense.)
english_loanwords_dakshina.attribution: Roark et al. 2020, LREC — the Dakshina dataset. Google Research, v1.0 (2020-05-27).
english_loanwords_dakshina.pin: data/loanwords/english_loans.json, built 2026-08-08 by scripts/build_english_loans.py; source checksums in the artifact's _meta; verify with --verify
english_loanwords_dakshina.maintenance: upstream released once (2020) and not updated; artifact rebuildable and checksummed
english_loanwords_dakshina.notes: ⚠️ GATED ON ORTHOGRAPHY ALREADY PROVING NON-NATIVENESS. Ungated, the romanization signal fired on 15 of 56 native words — கால்→'call', கார்→'car'. Share-alike, so it must stay labelled CC BY-SA in any export.

en_wiktionary_etymology.name: English Wiktionary (etymology)
en_wiktionary_etymology.pin: no pin — live source, cached per claim with its retrieval date
en_wiktionary_etymology.notes: Read per ===Etymology N=== block, one per SENSE (D-015): ranking templates across the whole section picked `bor` over `inh` every time and labelled four core native words வடசொல். A cached etymology is a PARSE, not raw source — clear the cache after any adapter change or the sweep measures stale data.

s2pt.name: Sanskrit-To-Pure-Tamil (community தனித்தமிழ் lists)
s2pt.licence: UNSTATED — no LICENSE file and no terms in the README.
s2pt.notes: ⚠️ THE ONE GENUINE LICENCE GAP WE SHIP, and the source that motivated this registry. A 'MIT' claim was carried for weeks and WITHDRAWN 2026-08-08 — sibling repos in the same org do carry MIT, which suggests omission rather than intent to restrict, but an omission is not a grant. Its own four upstreams are scraped community sites with unstated terms. Grade D caps it at 0.55, the lowest committing score, and the evidence string names the weakness in the answer itself. Never cite it as a settled licence; never call it an anchor.

supersession.intent: Marked for supersession by authenticated sources — TVA / government கலைச்சொல் glossaries and comparable gold sources. The SourceAdapter seam makes it a drop-in swap.
supersession.blocked_on: an authenticated equivalent source being wired (see kalaichol)

madras_tamil_lexicon.name: Madras Tamil Lexicon
madras_tamil_lexicon.licence: CC BY-NC-ND 2.0 — © University of Madras (original 1924–1936); DSAL digitization refreshed September 2023.
madras_tamil_lexicon.pin: not vendored — query-time only, by licence
madras_tamil_lexicon.maintenance: digitization maintained by DSAL; the lexicon itself is a fixed historical work
madras_tamil_lexicon.notes: ⚠️ GRADE A AND consult-and-cite AT THE SAME TIME — this entry is the reason grade and redistribution are separate axes. It is the most authoritative lexicon we have and the most restrictively licensed. NC bites because thamizh-mcp is Apache-2.0 and anyone may run it commercially; ND bites because a restructured store is plausibly a derivative. When wired: no bundled copy, query-time lookup, cache in the gitignored knowledge.sqlite3 only, store the derived FACT and citation never the entry text, excluded from gold-corpus export, opt-in and disabled by default. Also robots.txt-blocked (Disallow: /cgi-bin/ is the only endpoint), so integration awaits written permission. Recorded honestly: this is the cautious reading, and Saran is approaching DSAL for permission.
